name: BDB
summary: 1,3-Benzodioxolylbutanamine (BDB), also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-α-ethylphenethylamine or as J, is an entactogen of the phenethylamine, phenylisobutylamine, and MDxx families related to MDMA.

pharmacology.text: Receptor and transporter interaction data have been reported for BDB. It acts as a serotonin–norepinephrine releasing agent (SNDRA) with only weak effects on dopamine. Animal studies and anecdotal reports have found that BDB is a slightly more potent serotonin releasing agent than its methylated sister compound methylbenzodioxylbutanamine (MBDB; "Eden", "Methyl-J").

uses.text: Rather than as a recreational drug itself, BDB is more commonly known as a metabolite of the N-alkylated analogues MBDB and ethylbenzodioxylbutanamine (EBDB; "Ethyl-J"), which have appeared in MDMA or "ecstasy" tablets.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it on its own in people. Entactogens of the MDxx family can cause jaw clenching, a raised heart rate and blood pressure, overheating, sleeplessness and low mood afterwards, and raise the risk of serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 它單獨在人體中的作用所知甚少。MDxx 家族的同感劑可能造成咬牙、心跳與血壓上升、體溫過高、失眠與事後情緒低落，並提高血清素症候群的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它单独在人体中的作用所知甚少。MDxx 家族的同感剂可能造成咬牙、心跳与血压上升、体温过高、失眠与事后情绪低落，并提高血清素症候群的风险。

fact.en: BDB is sometimes called J, and it is best known as the compound the body makes when it breaks down MBDB, also known as Eden. It is MDMA's relative with an ethyl group in place of a methyl.
fact.zh: BDB 有時被稱為 J，它最為人知的身分是身體分解 MBDB（又稱 Eden）後產生的化合物。它是 MDMA 的親屬，把一個甲基換成了乙基。
fact.zhHans: BDB 有时被称为 J，它最为人知的身分是身体分解 MBDB（又称 Eden）后产生的化合物。它是 MDMA 的亲属，把一个甲基换成了乙基。
